credits.title: Atrápelo quien pueda
credits.overview: A widowed father, encouraged by his nine-year-old daughter, returns to dating after years away from romance. Following multiple failed attempts with various suitors, he discovers that true love was closer than he imagined.

credits.title: Son-in-Law
credits.overview: José Sánchez has big ambitions, terrible instincts, and a mustache to match. After a string of bad deals, he accidentally bluffs his way into becoming El Serpiente, a political boss feared for all the wrong reasons. Now he must pull off one final deal to stay alive — a deal far beyond anything he can fake.

credits.title: Maria, I'm Dying!
credits.overview: “Maria, I'm dying!” is a comedy about a hypochondriac man, the only being in the world capable of even terminal colds, and his wife who has to put up with it until he decides to do something about it. The fear of death has never been so fun.

credits.title: Quiero tu vida
credits.overview: A former pro football player must retire after a life-altering injury, and as the years passes he wishes to know how his life would've turned out had he remained a star.

credits.title: Amores permitidos
credits.overview: Rodrigo and Gabriela have been dating for years, sometimes their relationship seems like best friends, but deep down, they love each other. Their daily lives are disrupted when their best friends, Luz and Jorge, ask them who would be allowed.

credits.title: Enfermo Amor
credits.overview: The story of love struggles of 9 different couples, connected only by the complexity of human relationships.

credits.title: Bankrolled
credits.overview: While blind drunk, two unemployed millennials entrepreneurs drunkenly post a video pitch about their revolutionary app to a crowdfunding site. When the app catches fire and they accidentally raise millions of dollars they actually have to create the app.

credits.title: Instructions for Su
credits.overview: Su, a woman whose friends are only men, finds herself forced to follow a series of absurd instructions to overcome the unexpected death of her fiancé.

credits.title: Veinteañera, divorciada y fantástica
credits.overview: Regina, our young protagonist, always dreamed of getting married. And she did it - but the dream lasted much less than she thought and now she has to face life in a very funny way as a divorcee.

credits.title: For Better, For Worse
credits.overview: Sebastian and Valeria are about to get married. Everything seems perfect but a woman tries to seduce Sebastian while Valeria is pregnant.

credits.title: El imperio gay, la desaparición
credits.overview: The world has woken up surprised by a massive catastrophe, the disappearance of millions of people who are apparently homosexual.
